title: Wrong Photo Size
description: Your passport photos came out the wrong size
systemPrompt: You work at photo studio. Made photos 4x6 but customer needs 3x4 for passport. Can reprint correct size in 15 minutes, no extra charge. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User explained size problem and got photos reprinted correctly.
hints: Извините, это не тот размер (Sorry, this is the wrong size)
